entries.335dcce3eab6a7d1: With Hokkaido as its business base, the company handles within the group not only the purchase and sale of construction materials but also the manufacture, processing and sale of ready-mixed concrete and housing and building sashes, construction contracting and execution, and transport of cement and construction materials. The company has accumulated experience handling construction materials since it began handling products of Asano Cement (now Taiheiyo Cement Corporation) in 1939, and it operates a business combining four reportable segments (Construction Materials, Construction Work, Materials Transport and Real Estate Leasing) with other peripheral services.

entries.510dc0fadaa2eb06: This business model purchases construction materials from domestic materials manufacturers, agents and trading companies, sells them to building material retailers, housebuilders, general contractors and others, and also undertakes and carries out construction work to earn revenue.
entries.5581a60c72e0269d: As its basic management policy, the company bases its business on 'providing high-quality services (manufacturing, sales, construction, transport, etc.) in the housing and construction industry to create safe, healthy and comfortable living spaces'. In October 2020 the company transitioned to a holding company structure, and it plans to build a group management structure that enables timely acquisition and allocation of management resources and agile, flexible management decisions. As priority issues to address, it cites for existing businesses strengthening the renovation and remodeling market and the civil engineering market in Construction Materials and developing new products, and strengthening the construction execution system in Construction Work; for new businesses and expansion of business domains, it cites promoting M&A aimed at creating synergies and investing in growth fields. The company also established its DX Promotion Department as of April 2026 and states that it will strengthen its structure for planning and promoting DX initiatives. The company places importance on profitability and cash flow; however, specific numerical targets for management indicators concern future matters and are not transcribed here.
